challenge.better_approach: Looked: reuse before build. Seals go only through reseal.reseal_all, tickets only through cast_ticket, questions only through cairn question, timing only through the scheduler; each piece adds one reader or one verb on those doors.
challenge.hidden_assumption: That a dependent's seal evidence.reached names the components it reached (ticket 734b22d09f2e), so yellow and its dependents are readable from seals alone; and that the base shim's pulse runs on every device that has a list.
challenge.prior_art: Consulted the tickets corpus and the inspector: 50e0581737e8 (dependent-side yellow), the reseal ladder 4d9115eb04cd (rung 3 troubles, rung 4 decisions), 39eccfbc09aa (every sieve carries its why), ddc5cb6694d3 and eb27604ab267 (NOTRUN seals nothing). None does this piece; each is reused.
challenge.real_collision: None exclusive: the bounds of 93fa3e3a6199 and its children also touch build_inspector, recorded as an ordering note, not a collision.

answers.falsifier: (1) A's proofs green at its fingerprint and B's proof sealed with a reached digest of A from before A changed: colors[A] is yellow, waiting_on names B's proof. (2) after B's proof reseals with the current digest of A, colors[A] is green. (3) A with a stale own seal reads red whatever its dependents say, and no finding or gate changes because a component is yellow.
answers.from_idea: none, because outline 9.4.2.3.7 in press_office/CairnComponentOutline.txt (Akien 2026-11-13, at commit 198f4ef24) is the design these tickets carry
answers.how: One reader beside component_color, `yellow_until_dependents_reseal(row, comp_dir, repo_root)`, inverts the 50e0581737e8 yellows: a_reached_component_moved marks the DEPENDENT's proof yellow; this marks the CHANGED component yellow while any such dependent proof stands. inspect() reports it per component in its `colors` beside the findings, never as a finding, so no gate refuses on yellow (9.4.2.3.7.1: yellow is in service).
answers.traces_to: Law 9 (red is the default, green is earned) and outline 9.4.2.3.7.1 (in service at 80% trust)
answers.what: component_color derives yellow for a component whose own proofs are green at its current fingerprint while some other component's proof still carries a reached digest of it from before its change.

bullets.text: a component reads yellow until what depends on it is resealed: one piece of outline 9.4.2.3.7, cast with its siblings
